component.name: Airlock
component.summary: Workspace-isolated Alt+Tab switcher for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Airlock takes over Alt+Tab on the COSMIC desktop and lists only the windows of the current workspace, in most-recently-used order — nothing you parked on another workspace leaks into your focus. Sticky windows appear everywhere, minimized windows nowhere.

The overlay shows each window's application icon and title on a compact card; releasing Alt focuses the selection. Alt+grave cycles the current application's windows and Alt+Esc toggles to the previous one. A small daemon keeps the compositor state and switches in single-digit milliseconds; `airlock install` claims the keybind at user level and `airlock install --uninstall` restores the previous state byte-exactly.

ul.li: Workspace-isolated Alt+Tab overlay with application icons, MRU ordering, arrow keys, Enter commit, Escape dismiss.
Same-application cycling (Alt+grave) and no-overlay quick toggle (Alt+Esc).
Pointer input on the overlay — hover moves the selection, click activates, the wheel steps — and direct Ctrl+1..9 row selection, with each row's key shown beside it.
Long lists show a fixed eight-row window with continuation marks; a theme setting (dark/light/auto, default auto) follows the desktop's dark/light preference.
Per-workspace isolation config; installer-managed keybind takeover with byte-exact uninstall.
